=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/check_failure_triage.sh | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: With `CHECK_TRIAGE_PR_HEAD_ROUTING_ENABLED=true`, an unverified route on a PR whose base check passed exits at the base gate as `pr_specific_failure`; the `routing_unverified` log and WARNING are never reached.
  WHY: No issue is filed, so the safety property holds; the requested observability is missing when the base is green.
- .github/workflows/check_failure_triage.yml (step "Diagnose check failure") and scripts/check_failure_triage.sh line 280 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: A reviewer reports that the diagnose step does not receive `TG_BOT_SECRET`, so the WARNING added at line 280 may not be delivered.
  WHY: If the secret is absent, `tg_send_msg` returns without sending; the script still exits 1, so no unsafe behavior results.
- README.md | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The README rows for `CHECK_TRIAGE_PR_HEAD_ROUTING_ENABLED` and `CHECK_FAILURE_TRIAGE_BASE_GATE_ENABLED` say only a verified `orchestrator/project-<N>` route bypasses the base gate, but do not say that a verified PR-head route also bypasses it (`base_gate outcome=file reason=pr_head_route`).
  WHY: This is documentation drift; an operator could expect a routed PR with a green base to still end as `pr_specific_failure`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
